entities.name: Carl August Ehrensvärd
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: General Count Carl August Ehrensvärd was a Swedish Army officer. Ehrensvärd came from a distinguished family with a military background. His father was Admiral Count Carl August Ehrensvärd, Swedish Minister for Naval Affairs, and his great-grandfather was the renowned fortress builder Augustin Ehrensvärd.
